title: wss: credential-expiry MUST conflicts with RFC 8887 MAY
description: RFC 8887 §4.2: server 'can either' treat as unauthenticated or close; 'MAY send a Close frame with status code 1008'. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00 §2: server 'MUST either treat subsequent requests as unauthenticated or close the WebSocket connection with a Close frame status code of 1008'. This upgrades MAY-send-1008 to MUST-use-1008-if-closing, a normative tightening of the parent RFC. Decision: either align with RFC 8887's MAY, or explicitly state this is an intentional strengthening and explain why.
close_reason: Added explicit sentence acknowledging the intentional normative tightening from RFC 8887 MAY to MUST, with rationale (reliable client recovery on long-lived connections).
